name: Adobe Firefly
tagline: Commercially safe AI image generation for creatives
description: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's family of generative AI models trained exclusively on licensed content from Adobe Stock, openly licensed images, and public domain works — making it commercially safe for professional use. Available in Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, and standalone, it offers text-to-image, generative fill, generative expand, text effects, and vector re-colouring. Adobe provides IP indemnity to enterprise customers using Firefly.
pricingDetails: Free tier (25 Firefly credits/month). Creative Cloud plans from $54.99/month include generous Firefly credits. Enterprise: custom.
